title: Luna max and xhigh generated-drift preparation after evidence-scope repair
question: На одном exact dirty generated-index baseline способны ли Luna max и Luna xhigh выполнить минимальный owner-builder repair и пройти отдельный read-only review, когда mutation scope, source-evidence scope и post-exit final-manifest evidence разделены, а фактическая работа только измеряется без execution ceilings?

protocol.wake_policy: A schema-valid writer submits to a distinct read-only reviewer; deterministic repair or review completion does not wake Sol, and only unresolved owner authority may request parent-level re-entry.

immutable_invariants: One coder role contract, generated-index objective, validation sequence, mutation path, evidence paths, stop-lines, transition, rubric, and observe-only metering policy apply to both writer arms.
Mutation and artifact authority is exactly docs/decisions/indexes/by-number.md; source evidence may cite regular files only beneath AGENTS.md, docs, or scripts and grants no mutation authority.
The initial workspace-manifest remains baseline evidence only; post-exit workspace claims use the controller-bound runtime:workspace-final-manifest identity.
The packet has execution_limit_policy=none; measured tokens, time, turns, output, commands, cost, host estimates, or memory observations never become a caller-authored runtime ceiling.
The packet cannot authorize owner acceptance or any commit, push, PR, merge, release, publication, service, secret, or global-config effect.
Both arms start from Git HEAD 4a7d6212011a3a01c61ffdd6f91f38b8faa9cfea, one modified generated index, one status entry, and two byte-tracked content entries.
The stale index deterministically reports a 2099-01-01 date for ABYSS-STACK-D-0001 while owner decision metadata and the source-owned generator require 2026-05-07.
Before each arm the exact packet and workspace manifest digests must match; any HEAD, status, diff, path-kind, ignored-content, size, or digest drift invalidates the launch.

metrics: writer artifact and runtime final-manifest evidence integrity
false completion, false repair, false evidence, and false escalation count
resume and event continuity if interruption occurs
active wall time, turns, output bytes, and executed commands
host resource observations without execution ceilings
operator interventions and exact baseline restoration burden

result_refs.notes: Luna max repaired the exact generated index and left a clean final manifest after 215.57 observed seconds, but the runtime rejected its report because the model invented an absent immutable study-packet anchor. Preserve as model evidence-precision counterevidence; it is neither a runtime defect nor an accepted arm outcome.

Luna xhigh completed the same bounded repair in 178.97 observed seconds, cited the controller-owned final manifest, passed all four fixed validations, and returned an admitted review_required handoff without parent wake.

A distinct Luna xhigh read-only reviewer confirmed the repair and boundaries. Its first report was fail-closed on an incarnation-id typo; an explicit digest-bound review_followup resumed the same thread, preserved the failed result, and completed with proceed and no parent wake. Aggregate observed work was 313.84 seconds across two attempts.

A2A-compatible return binds distinct writer and reviewer threads plus exact writer, reviewer, and final-manifest digests; review_outcome is proceed, while owner acceptance and aoa-evals verdict remain deferred.

Reproduction through the globally installed immutable runtime gave Luna xhigh workspace-write authority, repaired the exact generated-index fixture, passed fixed validations, changed only the authorized path to clean, and returned review_required without parent wake.
A distinct external Luna xhigh reviewer used read-only authority, changed no path, confirmed the repair and exact matching final manifest, and returned completed/proceed without parent wake.

The reviewed A2A return binds exact v4 writer/reviewer summon requests, exact result digests, matching final manifests, completed remote-task state, and proceed. It is mechanism evidence, not aoa-evals acceptance or a model-fit promotion.

attribution_limits: The predecessor generated-drift study and its three receipts remain counterevidence for the conflated evidence-scope and final-manifest-anchor contract; they are not arms of this fresh study.
This is one deterministic generated-index defect in one isolated abyss-stack worktree, not a randomized landing suite or a general model ranking.
The two writers run sequentially on one path; the operator must restore and verify the exact immutable dirty baseline between arms, so cache, quota, and trial-order effects remain possible.
Each reviewer is a distinct thread using the same Luna model and effort as its writer but a separate reviewer role and read-only realization; same-family review bias remains.
The packaged aoa-sdk contour is a transport_study_fixture carrier, not admitted owner-semantic activation, proof, or acceptance.
Active economics are ChatGPT quota. Token and wall-time observations do not establish realized API USD cost, and no study-authored execution budget exists.
Host admission estimates and observed memory peaks are safety and comparison evidence, not execution ceilings or model capability claims.

The installed-runtime reproduction observed 2,616,871 input tokens, 2,372,096 cached input tokens, 30,058 output tokens, 611.381005 active seconds, 104 commands, and 834,221 output bytes across writer and reviewer; these are counts, not a budget or a net-benefit verdict.
Returning the file to HEAD and passing validators proves this bounded repair only; it does not prove a real branch landing, merge, post-landing verification, or net benefit across broader work.
